meta.name: opencode-qa
meta.description: QA opencode itself, per case: verify the CLI/terminal (opencode run, db, serve, export), prove a specific plugin hook/action/event fired via the SSE event stream, smoke-test the TUI under tmux, and investigate sessions in opencode's SQLite DB by id, title/name, or message text. Ships tested helper scripts (each with a --self-test) plus per-domain references. Use whenever someone wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug opencode's CLI, HTTP server, plugin hooks/events, or TUI, or to find/inspect opencode sessions in the database. Triggers: opencode qa, qa opencode, test opencode, verify opencode hook, opencode session db, find opencode session by id/name/text, opencode tui test, opencode server health, opencode event stream.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用配套脚本对 opencode 自身做质检:验证 CLI/HTTP 服务、通过 SSE 事件流确认插件 hook 是否触发、在 tmux 下冒烟测试 TUI,并按 id/标题/消息内容查询 SQLite 会话。每个脚本都有 --self-test 自检。
howto.when: 当你提出“测试/质检 opencode”或想验证其 CLI、HTTP 服务、插件 hook/事件、TUI,或按 id/名称/消息查找会话时触发;触发词如“opencode qa”“test opencode”“opencode session db”等。

say.text: 帮我 QA 一下 opencode 的 CLI,跑一遍自检。
say.note: Claude 会执行 opencode run 等命令验证。

say.text: 验证一下插件 hook 有没有触发,盯 SSE 事件流。
在 tmux 里冒烟测试 TUI,确认会话库没被写脏。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can QA opencode itself using bundled scripts: verify the CLI/HTTP server, confirm plugin hooks fire via the SSE event stream, smoke-test the TUI under tmux, and query SQLite sessions by id/title/message text. Every script has a --self-test.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to test/QA opencode, verify its CLI, HTTP server, plugin hook/event, or TUI, or find sessions by id/name/message. Example triggers: "opencode qa", "test opencode", "opencode session db".

say_en.text: QA opencode's CLI for me, run the self-tests.
say_en.note: Claude runs opencode run and related checks.

say_en.text: Verify whether that plugin hook fired, watch the SSE stream.
Smoke-test the TUI under tmux, ensure the session DB is untouched.
say_en.note: Claude runs tui-smoke.sh and compares session counts.
